snippet.title: Pop Optics - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4325500/Pop_Optics/

Pop Optics is a trippy throwback bullet-hell where you will run around avoiding teardrops, explosions, and lasers that you yourself are controlling! The laser-firing eyeballs focus on your cursor while you navigate the game board.

#roguelite #bullethell #indiegame
